rows.TEXT: My wares can help you in your quest.
Everything I possess is for sale.
Are you in need of recruits?
Are you in need of pets?
I have potent spells at a reasonable price.
Crrraaack! Oh my! Was it your neck that just snapped?
In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for her blood thirsts. It is said that she once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Cleric 
"We have restored order to these islands. Despite our losses, we will work to rebuild our lives."

Ashkael 
"Let our enemies suffer the fate of fools -  let us deliver them to their damnation."

Pegasus Knight 
"The spies have returned with astounding news! We have finally located  the Holy Chalice of Stagyrias! The city is just north of our capital, the treasure under the control of the Anzryft Dwarves."

Cleric 
"With all due respect my Lord, the Maldyn Islands are under the control of our enemies. Your mad ambitions to find the Chalice have compromised our quests in the past."

Squire 
"There is a foul stench in this cave. We must proceed with caution; there could be anything living...or unliving...down here."

Anzryft Dwarf 
"These islands are now under the rule of the Anzryft Dwarves. All uninvited guests will be swiftly executed!"

Pegasus Knight 
"Cursed fool! Mere snow shall not stop us! The Empire shall take back its property! Stagyrias shall fall and the Holy Chalice will be mine!"

Hu'Larsh 
"Look upon the faces of your men, women and children. Look upon the faces of those who have died. There is an unsettling feeling in the familiarity - isn't there? Listen to the cries of the widows longing for their families."

Pegasus Knight 
"You...sick...depraved...prepare yourself, foul creature! Prepare to embrace oblivion!"

Hu' Larsh 
"Embrace it? I have transcended death! If it is power that your heart desires, seek me. I can take away your weakness."

Pegasus Knight 
"Rest assured, we will seek you."

Death Knight 
"Mortis shall revel in your misfortune!"

Hu'Larsh 
"I will bring you a small taste of death's eternal glory."

Death Knight 
"Soon you will all join us."

Death Knight 
"There...do you not feel Mortis' power?"

Squire 
"My Lord, we are confused! Shall we continue on our quest for the Holy Chalice as ordered? Do we seek Hu'Larsh? What of the two cities that we must capture?"

Pegasus Knight 
"The Holy Chalice is a priority; we need every advantage that we can get. Our enemies are very resourceful."

Paladin 
"The cities are heavily protected, but we will need to claim them. Hu' Larsh is incredibly  powerful, but certain to hold items of value to the Empire as well. I suspect we shall need to deal with all of these tasks in time."

Duke 
"The Unholy Chalice is around here I can sense its filthy power. The port city! Yes! The Unholy Chalice must be in Brigham's Port!"

Cleric 
"...the widows formed a circle and began the ceremony. The 'Witch' was soon confronted by a real witch, one loyal to Bethrezen. The Witch of the Scorned killed her rival."

Cleric 
"The Witch of the Scorned, however, had a secret, for she was not loyal to our people. Smoke billowed up from her cloak and in her place appeared an undead beast!"

Cleric 
"The lich calls herself Hu'Larsh. She informed the widows not to worry, for they would see their families will retur, only  not as they  were before. They shall return as ghosts, specters and zombies. The ceremony had been a trick!"

Cultist  
"...the widows had formed a circle and the ceremony was underway. One of our witches confronted their  'Witch of the Scorned' and was slain."

Cultist  
"I heard her gloat, declaring the ceremony a ruse. With the pretense over, the imposter revealed her true self. Standing in her place was a lich."

Cultist  
"The Lich,  Hu'Larsh,  declared that widows would be reunited with their families. Not human as they were before, but as specters and zombies. Their loved ones shall return as the walking Undead."

Duke  
"Why do you bore me with your blabbering? We are here to destroy, not to tell stories! Neither Undead filth nor Human waste shall stand in my way."

Hu' Larsh 
"Fools! I have died before! Take the damned ring; you will not have it long. At this moment, death sends her champions to avenge me."

Cultist 
"My Lord, Here is an altar dedicated to some ancient entity. We must proceed with caution!"

Duke 
"Caution? You should be cautious when you assume I care about your superstitions."

Wraith 
"Enjoy the moment, for the forces of darkness will regroup."

Pegasus Knight 
"With this city under our occupation we are closer to our complete victory!"

Cultist 
"My Lord, I have learned that the Empire seeks to capture this city."

Duke 
"Our enemies shall not set foot here!"

Duke 
"Yes, it's difficult to threaten us without your tongue, isn't it?"

Squire 
"My Lord, rumor has it that the Legions of the Damned are interested in this city. What are we to do?"

Pegasus Knight 
"I could use some words of wisdom myself, sadly, I have none. We will fight whatever they send. It is all we can do."

Duke 
"No, I seek to deliver you to your damnation!"

Pegasus Knight 
"We have won a battle on this day, however, our work has merely begun. I suspect that keeping this city will be a  challenge."

Duke 
"Finally! The Chalice is ours! Blood will taste all the sweeter from its golden rim!"

Squire 
"My Lord, the people here have suffered greatly. From the time of the Great Wars to the tragedy of today. Can we not forget about the Holy Chalice and help our brothers and sisters restore their humanity?"

Pegasus Knight 
"We've all suffered greatly. I have lost many dear to me. Still, I march forward. I refuse to live in self pity. These people will be better served once we have the Holy Chalice."

Specter 
"The time of the living has come to its end. The spirits of the fallen yearn for freedom."
